question: Frontex runs a network of so-called partnership academies which is intended to promote cooperation with border and coast guard training institutions in the Member States. Such partnerships currently exist in Belgium, Bulgaria, Denmark, Germany Estonia, Finland, France, Italy, Croatia, Latvia, Lithuania, Malta, the Netherlands, Norway, Austria, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Sweden, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Czechia, Hungary and Cyprus. 1.
In which cities of which countries are training activities in connection with these Frontex partnerships already up and running or, if not yet, when are they scheduled to begin?
How many people per year receive training in these locations under Frontex training programmes or how many are intended to be trained there in the future?
Which Standing Corps categories and which training programmes are offered in the respective cities?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (15.12.2025) As the question falls under the responsibility of the European Border and Coast Guard Agency (Frontex), the Commission has asked the Agency to provide a response to the question raised by the Honourable Member. The Commission will send the Agency’s reply to the Honourable Member as soon as possible.
